findings.summary: The mistake bullet presents ChainedAssignmentError as the warning raised everywhere, but the warning depends on the pandas version.
findings.evidence: Assigning into a filtered slice changes nothing and warns: ChainedAssignmentError
findings.fix: Say it depends on version: pandas 3.0 (Copy-on-Write) emits ChainedAssignmentError and the assignment never takes effect, while pandas 2.x and earlier emit SettingWithCopyWarning and may or may not modify the original. Alternatively recommend .loc or assign() without naming one warning.
